instruction: The shared whitespace splitter in `textutils/_helpers.py` splits on single spaces only, so runs of spaces produce empty words and corrupt `reverse_words`, `capitalize_words`, and `wrap`. `reverse_words('a  b   c')` returns `c   b  a` instead of `c b a`.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/textutils/_helpers.py b/textutils/_helpers.py
--- a/textutils/_helpers.py
+++ b/textutils/_helpers.py
@@ -10,7 +10,7 @@
 
 def split_words(text: str) -> list[str]:
     """Split ``text`` into words on whitespace, dropping empty strings."""
-    return text.split(" ")
+    return text.split()
